[[Rrogozhinë|Rrogozhinë Municipality]] (25%){{cite web|title=EKSTRAKT HISTORIK I REGJISTRIT TË PRONARIT PËRFITUES|website=Ministria e Financave dhe Ekonomisë e Shqipërisë|url=https://opencorporates.al/documents/dokumenta/1712843898EkstraktHistorik-4_11_2024%20(1).pdf|access-date=2 May 2024|language=Albanian|archive-date=2 May 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240502114355/https://opencorporates.al/documents/dokumenta/1712843898EkstraktHistorik-4_11_2024%20(1).pdf|url-status=live}} | chrtitle = President | chairman = Agim Demrozi | manager = [[Nevil Dede]] | league = [[Kategoria Superiore]] | season = [[2025–26 Kategoria Superiore|2025–26]] | position = [[Kategoria Superiore]], 1st (champions) | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _jomavictory1gb | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 00792b | body1 = 00792b | rightarm1 = 00792b | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = _jomatoletum5wb | pattern_b2 = _jomatoletum5wb | pattern_ra2 = _jomatoletum5wb | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = ffffff | body2 = ffffff | rightarm2 = ffffff | shorts2 = ffffff | socks2 = ffffff }} '''KF Egnatia''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi i Futbollit Egnatia}}) is an Albanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Rrogozhinë]]. The club competes in [[Kategoria Superiore]], the top tier of [[Football in Albania|Albanian football]]. Their home ground is [[Egnatia Arena]], which has a capacity of 5,000 spectators. The club was founded on 15 September 1934 under the name 22 Shtatori Rrogozhinë. In 1991 the name of the club was changed to Vullneti Rrogozhinë, before being renamed to Egnatia, in 1998. The club secured its first championship title in 2024. The club's name derives from the ancient [[Via Egnatia]], the Roman road that passed through the Rrogozhinë area. The road itself was named after [[Gnaeus Egnatius]], the Roman proconsul of the [[Macedonia (Roman province)|Roman province of Macedonia]] who oversaw its construction in the 2nd century BC."}}
